style.backgroundSystem: ivory paper field #F2EEE6 as the primary background for packshot, benefit and infographic screens, alternating with a deep tea-brown field #5A4433 for the claim screen, a bamboo-slat mat #C69A5F for texture screens and the champagne satin lining #EBD3A0 for the open gift-tin interior; one single flat plane per screen, no gradient, no marble, no wood table, no pure seamless studio white, no landscape scenery
style.direction: quiet ivory still-life tonic gift-box commerce
style.iconSystem: hollow thin-line icons at one uniform stroke weight in satin gold #EBD3A0 on the deep brown field #5A4433 and in tea-brown #5A4433 on ivory #F2EEE6, each icon inside an empty dotted-outline circle, max six per screen
style.lightingSystem: neutral 5600K soft studio light, broad top key with a large left fill card, low contrast, fibrous matte highlights only, controlled contact shadow that always grounds the product, never a glossy plastic sheen and never flash bounce
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent quiet ivory still-life tonic gift-box ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of an ivory paper field #F2EEE6, a deep tea-brown text color #5A4433, a bamboo-slat warm brown #C69A5F and a champagne satin accent #EBD3A0; neutral tone; neutral 5600K soft studio lighting with a broad top key, a large left fill card, low contrast, matte fibrous highlights and a controlled contact shadow that grounds the product, never a glossy plastic sheen; one modern geometric sans-serif for headline and label placeholders only with no calligraphy and no serif display; hollow thin-line icons of one uniform stroke weight, each inside an empty dotted-outline circle, no more than six per screen; premium tonic still-life photography mixed with minimal infographic elements on a single flat background plane per screen, no gradient and no pure white seamless studio paper; stable product scale and centered placement with the dried goods matte, fibrous and never bleached; generous ivory negative space; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no pure white seamless studio background or marble surface
no glossy plastic sheen on the food
no visible brand mark, QR code or member badge
style.presentationRules: stable product scale and centered stability across the set; the dried pieces always read matte, fibrous and dry with visible fine thread ends; rehydrated pieces read translucent with separated strands; the round tin is shown from directly above with its radial layout intact; no piece is recoloured, bleached or made glossy
style.surfaceSystem: ivory paper board #F2EEE6, bamboo-slat mat #C69A5F, champagne satin lining #EBD3A0 with a small key-fret weave, undyed linen cloth #E6DDCB, ivory glazed ceramic bowl #F6F2EA
style.typography: one modern geometric sans-serif for headline and label placeholders only; tea-brown #5A4433 lettering on light fields and ivory #F2EEE6 lettering on the deep brown field #5A4433; no calligraphy, no brush script, no serif display, no vertical letter columns
